IRDAI (Protection of Policyholders' Interests) Regulations, 2017 & Ombudsman Rules 2017/2023

Insurer Grievance Redressal Officers (GRO) are mandated by law to adjudicate representations within 15 consecutive days. Failure automatically perfects client locus standi before the Insurance Ombudsman under Rule 13(1)(b).
